_help: How to add a course: Find the target department and year array ('1st', '2nd', '3rd', '4th', or 'masters') below and add one object inside [ ]:
Separate multiple courses with a comma (,). Do not put a trailing comma after the last course.

File name rule: papers/{title}-{code}.html. Both title and code are lowercase, every space or symbol becomes a hyphen (-). Example: History of the Emergence of Independent Bangladesh + 211501 = papers/history-of-the-emergence-of-independent-bangladesh-211501.html
A course with no title uses only the code: papers/311101.html
Courses with the same title and code in different departments share the same file, so upload that file only once.
The file name in this list and the uploaded file in the papers folder must match exactly.
